cards.name: Boomerang
cards.text: Defeats Big Octos, removing Great Sea rules from that square.

cards.name: Hyoi Pear
cards.text: Uses Seagulls to find hidden treasure, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Wind Waker
cards.text: Stops headwinds, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally.

cards.name: Hammer
cards.text: Hits switches, revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Hero's Bow
cards.text: Destroys Cyclones, removing Great Sea rules from that square.

cards.name: Power Bracelet
cards.text: Lifts Stone Heads, revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Deku Leaf
cards.text: Spins windmills, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Cannon
cards.text: Destroys Warships, removing Great Sea rules from that square.

cards.name: Hookshot
cards.text: Pulls Warrior to a marked target, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally.

cards.name: Salvage Arm
cards.text: Hoists up buried treasure, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Compass
cards.text: Reveals all secrets within a battle square, making their tiles sparkle.

cards.name: Sea Map
cards.text: Updated by Fishman, revealing enemies in that square.
